testCases.name: Related products lead to an out-of-stock item that still shows Add to Cart (KAN-15)
testCases.objective: Verify that the related products section on a product detail page links to another product, and that an out-of-stock product still displays its out-of-stock state and Add to Cart control.
testCases.precondition: 1. User is on the home page.

steps.step: From the home page, select the Pliers product.
steps.expected: The Pliers product detail page opens.

steps.step: Scroll to the bottom of the Pliers product detail page.
steps.expected: A "Related products" section is displayed at the bottom of the page.

steps.step: Select Long Nose Pliers from the related products section.
steps.expected: The Long Nose Pliers product detail page opens.

steps.step: Review the Long Nose Pliers product detail page.
steps.expected: An out-of-stock indicator reading "Out of stock" is displayed.

steps.step: Check the Add to Cart control on the Long Nose Pliers page.
steps.expected: The Add to Cart button is displayed but disabled (the quantity controls are also disabled).
